limitations: Uses the native DurableTaskRunner rather than the unavailable SDK harness; creates a real store conversation owner. No SDK session or effective-model report is claimed.

blockedBy: DurableStore's Auto/Jsonl/LegacyJson file providers throw; real close/reopen preserving task checkpoints and memos is required. An in-memory restart is not recovery parity.

examples.liveReason: Original submits a model turn and asserts the answer is Paris plus user/assistant/system transcript events.
blockedBy: DurableHarness, DurableConversation, AgentChoices, submit/context, SDK session attachment and prompt injection are absent.
Per-conversation AgentChoices, agent resolution, configure and BuildSystemMessage are absent. PromptSection alone cannot prove stored configuration isolation.

examples.liveReason: Original streams real model output and compares all delta characters to final answer length.
blockedBy: SDK harness/session binding, streaming configuration and event subscriptions are absent.

examples.liveReason: Original asks a model to select read/edit/shell tools and verifies actual file effects and hook timings.
blockedBy: DurableTool has only name/description; SDK handlers, argument schemas, built-in override, pre/post hooks and custom-tool permissions are absent.

examples.liveReason: Original awaits one model submission with built-in read permission and prints its final answer.
blockedBy: submit, answers, session binding and built-in read permission configuration are absent.

examples.liveReason: Original emits a snapshot followed by session events from a model/tool run, serialized as JSON objects.
blockedBy: context, submit, session event subscriptions and read permissions are absent.
requiredAssertions: every line is a JSON object

examples.liveReason: Original submits overlapping model turns and checks both inputs and per-submission answers were retained.
blockedBy: Durable admission queue, concurrent submit completions, transcript and answers are absent.

examples.liveReason: Original joins a streaming model run after 1.5 seconds and requires live deltas after the snapshot; timing is not guaranteed by a completed recording.
blockedBy: Streaming SDK session, context snapshot, delta subscriptions and submit are absent.

examples.liveReason: Original requires a parent model tool call to create an owned child session, await its answer, and return it to the parent.
blockedBy: SDK tools, nested submit, ownerConversationId session creation and custom-tool permissions are absent.
